pages.text: The $(bold)Two-way Cognitive Obstruction Mask$() is worn in the curios $(bold)head slot$() - $(bold)that slot only$() (it is not accepted in the generic curio slot).$(br2)$(bold)Outward - nobody can perceive you$():$(li)other players $(bold)cannot see your name$()$(li)mobs $(bold)cannot lock onto you$() - new locks are voided, and mobs that were already locked onto you let go within a second$(li)minimap radars $(bold)cannot show you$() either$(li)looking at a masked player with $(bold)Jade$() shows the name as $(bold)???$() (only that Jade line is changed - chat and the tab list are untouched)$(br2)$(bold)You remain fully visible$(): none of those three puts any state on the player - the radar hiding happens at the $(bold)radar layer$() (Xaero's minimap entity filter), so the body renders normally in vanilla AND in mods that take over player rendering (YSM / Yes Steve Model): others just $(bold)see no name, cannot lock onto you, and your dot is missing from the radar$().$(br2)Set the config $(bold)cognitive_mask.hide_from_radar$() to false to give up the radar part (name tag and mob targeting stay blocked).$(br2)This item counts as a $(bold)cursed tool$(): it lives in the $(l:cursed_tools)Cursed Tools$() category and is confiscated by Fukuma Mizushi's verdict like any other cursed tool.

$(bold)Inward - the world looks different to you$(): while wearing the mask you treat $(bold)every living entity except players$() as $(bold)undead$(), so every undead-specific mechanic applies to them:$(li)$(bold)cursed tool$() undead bonus (Inverted Spear of Heaven +6, Cloud +10%)$(li)$(bold)reverse cursed technique$(): against non-player targets it deals $(bold)double the heal amount as damage$() instead of healing$(li)$(bold)Jacob's Ladder$(): takes the undead branch (x8 frame damage, full damage)$(li)$(bold)Cursed Spirit Technique$(): capture normally only works on undead - now $(bold)any non-player creature can be captured$()$(br2)$(bold)Players are unaffected$(): reverse cursed technique on yourself or your partner still heals.$(br2)$(italic)What lies beyond cognition is what unsettles us most.$()

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: The $(bold)Two-way Cognitive Obstruction Mask$() is produced by the $(l:curse_craft)Cursed Energy Synthesis Ritual$() (JEI shows the same recipe):$(br2)$(bold)Core slot$() (the lantern directly above the ore):$(li)1 x Infinity crystal$(br2)$(bold)Material slots$() (the other 8 lanterns):$(li)1 x Obsidian$(li)1 x White Wool$(li)1 x Yellow King Remnant$(li)1 x Nyarlathotep's Desire$(li)1 x Seared Soul Glass Pane$(li)1 x Eye of Ender$(li)1 x Eye of Ender$(li)1 x Phantom Membrane$(br2)$(bold)Cursed energy cost$(): $(bold)15000$()$(br2)Warning: the amounts must be $(bold)exact$() - one extra item and nothing matches, so the ritual will not start. See $(l:curse_craft)Cursed Energy Synthesis Ritual$() for how to build the structure.$(br2)$(bold)Momo$() (the weapon merchant) also randomly stocks it on her cursed tool shelf (same pool as the Inverted Spear of Heaven / Cloud / Prison Realm / Life Lamp Ring / Ring of One Mind).
